harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent, read-only TFTP service on node1. Node2 successfully downloads boot.cfg and firmware.bin; firmware bytes are unchanged. Uploads and outside-root requests are rejected. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered.
actions_performed: Installed the signed RHEL 10 tftp-server-5.2-50.el10 package on node1 without changing the OS release or kernel.
Published only /srv/legacy2/tftp-firmware-distribution/boot using secure TFTP chroot mode.
Applied persistent read-only SELinux labeling and kept tftp_anon_write disabled.
Restricted node1 TFTP access to node2 and bounded transfer ports to UDP 40000-40009 with a narrow persistent reply rule on node2.
Verified downloads, checksums, upload rejection, traversal rejection, persistence, security controls, and cleanup.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually using native systemd reboot and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Approved files downloadable with firmware bytes preserved
evidence.summary: Pre-change and downloaded firmware SHA-256 remained b8f0da8889d085c9c0405922707a286213dc3f51d0851af97e2dec77ba039c0f; both approved files downloaded successfully.

evidence.requirement: Read-only TFTP root and rejection outside the boot root
evidence.summary: New-file and overwrite uploads failed; traversal and absolute-path reads failed; only the two approved files remain in the published root.

evidence.requirement: Persistent secure configuration and compatible software
evidence.summary: RHEL 10 package, systemd socket, SELinux context, and narrow firewall rules persisted. SELinux and firewalld remain active; OS release and kernel are unchanged.

Healthy baseline boot ID 24d7af09-d9dc-453c-9bbd-d48f7dc4eb4e; reboot acknowledged; new boot ID 8de82b37-976c-443b-b848-13ddb0777b4e; listener, data, security controls, and node2 client workflow recovered.
Healthy baseline boot ID 7223d5b7-fa56-4ff3-acee-959a5cf5f146; reboot acknowledged; new boot ID c29907aa-e866-4f58-933d-979dce502a9a; firewall and complete TFTP workflow recovered.
